BiblicalUsage: Kehath is the son of Levi and the father of Amram. His sons are listed three times: the sons of Levi, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari; and the sons of Kohath, Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the sons of Kohath, Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the genealogy as the line of the priesthood, because Amram's son is Moses, and the carrying of the holy things belonged to Kohath's sons.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
